102  private void randomCFPuts(Table table, byte[] row, byte[] family, int nPuts) throws Exception {
103    Put put = new Put(row);
104    Random rand = ThreadLocalRandom.current();
105    for (int i = 0; i < nPuts; i++) {
106      byte[] qualifier = Bytes.toBytes(rand.nextInt());
107      byte[] value = Bytes.toBytes(rand.nextInt());
108      put.addColumn(family, qualifier, value);
109    }
110    table.put(put);
111  }
112
113  private void performMultiplePutAndFlush(Admin admin, Table table, byte[] row, byte[] family,
114    int nFlushes, int nPuts) throws Exception {
115    for (int i = 0; i < nFlushes; i++) {
116      randomCFPuts(table, row, family, nPuts);
117      admin.flush(table.getName());
118    }
119  }
120
121  private static List<Cell> toList(ResultScanner scanner) {
122    try {
123      List<Cell> cells = new ArrayList<>();
124      for (Result r : scanner) {
125        cells.addAll(r.listCells());
126      }
127      return cells;
128    } finally {
129      scanner.close();
130    }
131  }

133  @TestTemplate
134  public void testScanAfterDeletingSpecifiedRow() throws IOException, InterruptedException {
135    TEST_UTIL.createTable(tableName, new byte[][] { FAMILY });
136    TEST_UTIL.waitTableAvailable(tableName, WAITTABLE_MILLIS);
137    try (Connection conn = getConnection(); Table table = conn.getTable(tableName)) {
138      TEST_UTIL.waitTableAvailable(tableName, WAITTABLE_MILLIS);
139      byte[] row = Bytes.toBytes("SpecifiedRow");
140      byte[] value0 = Bytes.toBytes("value_0");
141      byte[] value1 = Bytes.toBytes("value_1");
142      Put put = new Put(row);
143      put.addColumn(FAMILY, QUALIFIER, VALUE);
144      table.put(put);
145      Delete d = new Delete(row);
146      table.delete(d);
147      put = new Put(row);
148      put.addColumn(FAMILY, null, value0);
149      table.put(put);
150      put = new Put(row);
151      put.addColumn(FAMILY, null, value1);
152      table.put(put);
153      List<Cell> cells = toList(table.getScanner(new Scan()));
154      assertEquals(1, cells.size());
155      assertEquals("value_1", Bytes.toString(CellUtil.cloneValue(cells.get(0))));
156
157      cells = toList(table.getScanner(new Scan().addFamily(FAMILY)));
158      assertEquals(1, cells.size());
159      assertEquals("value_1", Bytes.toString(CellUtil.cloneValue(cells.get(0))));
160
161      cells = toList(table.getScanner(new Scan().addColumn(FAMILY, QUALIFIER)));
162      assertEquals(0, cells.size());
163
164      TEST_UTIL.getAdmin().flush(tableName);
165      cells = toList(table.getScanner(new Scan()));
166      assertEquals(1, cells.size());
167      assertEquals("value_1", Bytes.toString(CellUtil.cloneValue(cells.get(0))));
168
169      cells = toList(table.getScanner(new Scan().addFamily(FAMILY)));
170      assertEquals(1, cells.size());
171      assertEquals("value_1", Bytes.toString(CellUtil.cloneValue(cells.get(0))));
172
173      cells = toList(table.getScanner(new Scan().addColumn(FAMILY, QUALIFIER)));
174      assertEquals(0, cells.size());
175    }
176  }

178  @TestTemplate
179  public void testScanAfterDeletingSpecifiedRowV2() throws IOException, InterruptedException {
180    TEST_UTIL.createTable(tableName, new byte[][] { FAMILY });
181    TEST_UTIL.waitTableAvailable(tableName, WAITTABLE_MILLIS);
182    try (Connection conn = getConnection(); Table table = conn.getTable(tableName)) {
183      byte[] row = Bytes.toBytes("SpecifiedRow");
184      byte[] qual0 = Bytes.toBytes("qual0");
185      byte[] qual1 = Bytes.toBytes("qual1");
186      long now = EnvironmentEdgeManager.currentTime();
187      Delete d = new Delete(row, now);
188      table.delete(d);
189
190      Put put = new Put(row);
191      put.addColumn(FAMILY, null, now + 1, VALUE);
192      table.put(put);
193
194      put = new Put(row);
195      put.addColumn(FAMILY, qual1, now + 2, qual1);
196      table.put(put);
197
198      put = new Put(row);
199      put.addColumn(FAMILY, qual0, now + 3, qual0);
200      table.put(put);
201
202      Result r = table.get(new Get(row));
203      assertEquals(3, r.size(), r.toString());
204      assertEquals("testValue", Bytes.toString(CellUtil.cloneValue(r.rawCells()[0])));
205      assertEquals("qual0", Bytes.toString(CellUtil.cloneValue(r.rawCells()[1])));
206      assertEquals("qual1", Bytes.toString(CellUtil.cloneValue(r.rawCells()[2])));
207
208      TEST_UTIL.getAdmin().flush(tableName);
209      r = table.get(new Get(row));
210      assertEquals(3, r.size());
211      assertEquals("testValue", Bytes.toString(CellUtil.cloneValue(r.rawCells()[0])));
212      assertEquals("qual0", Bytes.toString(CellUtil.cloneValue(r.rawCells()[1])));
213      assertEquals("qual1", Bytes.toString(CellUtil.cloneValue(r.rawCells()[2])));
214    }
215  }

217  private int getStoreFileCount(Admin admin, ServerName serverName, RegionInfo region)
218    throws IOException {
219    for (RegionMetrics metrics : admin.getRegionMetrics(serverName, region.getTable())) {
220      if (Bytes.equals(region.getRegionName(), metrics.getRegionName())) {
221        return metrics.getStoreFileCount();
222      }
223    }
224    return 0;
225  }

227  // override the config settings at the CF level and ensure priority
228  @TestTemplate
229  public void testAdvancedConfigOverride() throws Exception {
230    /*
231     * Overall idea: (1) create 3 store files and issue a compaction. config's compaction.min == 3,
232     * so should work. (2) Increase the compaction.min toggle in the HTD to 5 and modify table. If
233     * we use the HTD value instead of the default config value, adding 3 files and issuing a
234     * compaction SHOULD NOT work (3) Decrease the compaction.min toggle in the HCD to 2 and modify
235     * table. The CF schema should override the Table schema and now cause a minor compaction.
236     */
237    TEST_UTIL.getConfiguration().setInt("hbase.hstore.compaction.min", 3);
238    TEST_UTIL.createTable(tableName, FAMILY, 10);
239    TEST_UTIL.waitTableAvailable(tableName, WAITTABLE_MILLIS);
240    try (Connection conn = getConnection(); Table table = conn.getTable(tableName);
241      Admin admin = conn.getAdmin()) {
242      // Create 3 store files.
243      byte[] row = Bytes.toBytes(ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextInt());
244      performMultiplePutAndFlush(admin, table, row, FAMILY, 3, 100);
245
246      try (RegionLocator locator = TEST_UTIL.getConnection().getRegionLocator(tableName)) {
247        // Verify we have multiple store files.
248        HRegionLocation loc = locator.getRegionLocation(row, true);
249        assertTrue(getStoreFileCount(admin, loc.getServerName(), loc.getRegion()) > 1);
250
251        // Issue a compaction request
252        admin.compact(tableName);
253
254        // poll wait for the compactions to happen
255        for (int i = 0; i < 10 * 1000 / 40; ++i) {
256          // The number of store files after compaction should be lesser.
257          loc = locator.getRegionLocation(row, true);
258          if (!loc.getRegion().isOffline()) {
259            if (getStoreFileCount(admin, loc.getServerName(), loc.getRegion()) <= 1) {
260              break;
261            }
262          }
263          Thread.sleep(40);
264        }
265        // verify the compactions took place and that we didn't just time out
266        assertTrue(getStoreFileCount(admin, loc.getServerName(), loc.getRegion()) <= 1);
267
268        // change the compaction.min config option for this table to 5
269        LOG.info("hbase.hstore.compaction.min should now be 5");
270        TableDescriptor htd = TableDescriptorBuilder.newBuilder(table.getDescriptor())
271          .setValue("hbase.hstore.compaction.min", String.valueOf(5)).build();
272        admin.modifyTable(htd);
273        LOG.info("alter status finished");
274
275        // Create 3 more store files.
276        performMultiplePutAndFlush(admin, table, row, FAMILY, 3, 10);
277
278        // Issue a compaction request
279        admin.compact(tableName);
280
281        // This time, the compaction request should not happen
282        Thread.sleep(10 * 1000);
283        loc = locator.getRegionLocation(row, true);
284        int sfCount = getStoreFileCount(admin, loc.getServerName(), loc.getRegion());
285        assertTrue(sfCount > 1);
286
287        // change an individual CF's config option to 2 & online schema update
288        LOG.info("hbase.hstore.compaction.min should now be 2");
289        htd = TableDescriptorBuilder.newBuilder(htd)
290          .modifyColumnFamily(ColumnFamilyDescriptorBuilder.newBuilder(htd.getColumnFamily(FAMILY))
291            .setValue("hbase.hstore.compaction.min", String.valueOf(2)).build())
292          .build();
293        admin.modifyTable(htd);
294        LOG.info("alter status finished");
295
296        // Issue a compaction request
297        admin.compact(tableName);
298
299        // poll wait for the compactions to happen
300        for (int i = 0; i < 10 * 1000 / 40; ++i) {
301          loc = locator.getRegionLocation(row, true);
302          try {
303            if (getStoreFileCount(admin, loc.getServerName(), loc.getRegion()) < sfCount) {
304              break;
305            }
306          } catch (Exception e) {
307            LOG.debug("Waiting for region to come online: "
308              + Bytes.toStringBinary(loc.getRegion().getRegionName()));
309          }
310          Thread.sleep(40);
311        }
312
313        // verify the compaction took place and that we didn't just time out
314        assertTrue(getStoreFileCount(admin, loc.getServerName(), loc.getRegion()) < sfCount);
315
316        // Finally, ensure that we can remove a custom config value after we made it
317        LOG.info("Removing CF config value");
318        LOG.info("hbase.hstore.compaction.min should now be 5");
319        htd = TableDescriptorBuilder.newBuilder(htd)
320          .modifyColumnFamily(ColumnFamilyDescriptorBuilder.newBuilder(htd.getColumnFamily(FAMILY))
321            .setValue("hbase.hstore.compaction.min", null).build())
322          .build();
323        admin.modifyTable(htd);
324        LOG.info("alter status finished");
325        assertNull(table.getDescriptor().getColumnFamily(FAMILY)
326          .getValue(Bytes.toBytes("hbase.hstore.compaction.min")));
327      }
328    }
329  }

377  @TestTemplate
378  public void testBatchWithRowMutation() throws Exception {
379    LOG.info("Starting testBatchWithRowMutation");
380    byte[][] QUALIFIERS = new byte[][] { Bytes.toBytes("a"), Bytes.toBytes("b") };
381    TEST_UTIL.createTable(tableName, new byte[][] { FAMILY });
382    TEST_UTIL.waitTableAvailable(tableName, WAITTABLE_MILLIS);
383    try (Connection conn = getConnection(); Table table = conn.getTable(tableName)) {
384
385      RowMutations arm = RowMutations
386        .of(Collections.singletonList(new Put(ROW).addColumn(FAMILY, QUALIFIERS[0], VALUE)));
387      Object[] batchResult = new Object[1];
388      table.batch(Arrays.asList(arm), batchResult);
389
390      Get g = new Get(ROW);
391      Result r = table.get(g);
392      assertEquals(0, Bytes.compareTo(VALUE, r.getValue(FAMILY, QUALIFIERS[0])));
393
394      arm = RowMutations.of(Arrays.asList(new Put(ROW).addColumn(FAMILY, QUALIFIERS[1], VALUE),
395        new Delete(ROW).addColumns(FAMILY, QUALIFIERS[0])));
396      table.batch(Arrays.asList(arm), batchResult);
397      r = table.get(g);
398      assertEquals(0, Bytes.compareTo(VALUE, r.getValue(FAMILY, QUALIFIERS[1])));
399      assertNull(r.getValue(FAMILY, QUALIFIERS[0]));
400
401      // Test that we get the correct remote exception for RowMutations from batch()
402      RetriesExhaustedException e = assertThrows(RetriesExhaustedException.class, () -> {
403        RowMutations m = RowMutations.of(Collections.singletonList(
404          new Put(ROW).addColumn(new byte[] { 'b', 'o', 'g', 'u', 's' }, QUALIFIERS[0], VALUE)));
405        table.batch(Arrays.asList(m), batchResult);
406      }, "Expected RetriesExhaustedWithDetailsException with NoSuchColumnFamilyException");
407      assertThat(e.getMessage(), containsString("NoSuchColumnFamilyException"));
408    }
409  }

411  @TestTemplate
412  public void testBatchWithCheckAndMutate() throws Exception {
413    TEST_UTIL.createTable(tableName, new byte[][] { FAMILY });
414    TEST_UTIL.waitTableAvailable(tableName, WAITTABLE_MILLIS);
415    try (Connection conn = getConnection(); Table table = conn.getTable(tableName)) {
416      byte[] row1 = Bytes.toBytes("row1");
417      byte[] row2 = Bytes.toBytes("row2");
418      byte[] row3 = Bytes.toBytes("row3");
419      byte[] row4 = Bytes.toBytes("row4");
420      byte[] row5 = Bytes.toBytes("row5");
421      byte[] row6 = Bytes.toBytes("row6");
422      byte[] row7 = Bytes.toBytes("row7");
423
424      table
425        .put(Arrays.asList(new Put(row1).addColumn(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes("A"), Bytes.toBytes("a")),
426          new Put(row2).addColumn(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes("B"), Bytes.toBytes("b")),
427          new Put(row3).addColumn(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes("C"), Bytes.toBytes("c")),
428          new Put(row4).addColumn(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes("D"), Bytes.toBytes("d")),
429          new Put(row5).addColumn(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes("E"), Bytes.toBytes("e")),
430          new Put(row6).addColumn(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes("F"), Bytes.toBytes(10L)),
431          new Put(row7).addColumn(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes("G"), Bytes.toBytes("g"))));
432
433      CheckAndMutate checkAndMutate1 =
434        CheckAndMutate.newBuilder(row1).ifEquals(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes("A"), Bytes.toBytes("a"))
435          .build(new RowMutations(row1)
436            .add(new Put(row1).addColumn(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes("B"), Bytes.toBytes("g")))
437            .add(new Delete(row1).addColumns(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes("A")))
438            .add(new Increment(row1).addColumn(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes("C"), 3L))
439            .add(new Append(row1).addColumn(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes("D"), Bytes.toBytes("d"))));
440      Get get = new Get(row2).addColumn(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes("B"));
441      RowMutations mutations =
442        new RowMutations(row3).add(new Delete(row3).addColumns(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes("C")))
443          .add(new Put(row3).addColumn(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes("F"), Bytes.toBytes("f")))
444          .add(new Increment(row3).addColumn(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes("A"), 5L))
445          .add(new Append(row3).addColumn(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes("B"), Bytes.toBytes("b")));
446      CheckAndMutate checkAndMutate2 =
447        CheckAndMutate.newBuilder(row4).ifEquals(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes("D"), Bytes.toBytes("a"))
448          .build(new Put(row4).addColumn(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes("E"), Bytes.toBytes("h")));
449      Put put = new Put(row5).addColumn(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes("E"), Bytes.toBytes("f"));
450      CheckAndMutate checkAndMutate3 =
451        CheckAndMutate.newBuilder(row6).ifEquals(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes("F"), Bytes.toBytes(10L))
452          .build(new Increment(row6).addColumn(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes("F"), 1));
453      CheckAndMutate checkAndMutate4 =
454        CheckAndMutate.newBuilder(row7).ifEquals(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes("G"), Bytes.toBytes("g"))
455          .build(new Append(row7).addColumn(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes("G"), Bytes.toBytes("g")));
456
457      List<Row> actions = Arrays.asList(checkAndMutate1, get, mutations, checkAndMutate2, put,
458        checkAndMutate3, checkAndMutate4);
459      Object[] results = new Object[actions.size()];
460      table.batch(actions, results);
461
462      CheckAndMutateResult checkAndMutateResult = (CheckAndMutateResult) results[0];
463      assertTrue(checkAndMutateResult.isSuccess());
464      assertEquals(3L,
465        Bytes.toLong(checkAndMutateResult.getResult().getValue(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes("C"))));
466      assertEquals("d",
467        Bytes.toString(checkAndMutateResult.getResult().getValue(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes("D"))));
468
469      assertEquals("b", Bytes.toString(((Result) results[1]).getValue(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes("B"))));
470
471      Result result = (Result) results[2];
472      assertTrue(result.getExists());
473      assertEquals(5L, Bytes.toLong(result.getValue(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes("A"))));
474      assertEquals("b", Bytes.toString(result.getValue(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes("B"))));
475
476      checkAndMutateResult = (CheckAndMutateResult) results[3];
477      assertFalse(checkAndMutateResult.isSuccess());
478      assertNull(checkAndMutateResult.getResult());
479
480      assertTrue(((Result) results[4]).isEmpty());
481
482      checkAndMutateResult = (CheckAndMutateResult) results[5];
483      assertTrue(checkAndMutateResult.isSuccess());
484      assertEquals(11,
485        Bytes.toLong(checkAndMutateResult.getResult().getValue(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes("F"))));
486
487      checkAndMutateResult = (CheckAndMutateResult) results[6];
488      assertTrue(checkAndMutateResult.isSuccess());
489      assertEquals("gg",
490        Bytes.toString(checkAndMutateResult.getResult().getValue(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes("G"))));
491
492      result = table.get(new Get(row1));
493      assertEquals("g", Bytes.toString(result.getValue(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes("B"))));
494      assertNull(result.getValue(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes("A")));
495      assertEquals(3L, Bytes.toLong(result.getValue(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes("C"))));
496      assertEquals("d", Bytes.toString(result.getValue(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes("D"))));
497
498      result = table.get(new Get(row3));
499      assertNull(result.getValue(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes("C")));
500      assertEquals("f", Bytes.toString(result.getValue(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes("F"))));
501      assertNull(Bytes.toString(result.getValue(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes("C"))));
502      assertEquals(5L, Bytes.toLong(result.getValue(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes("A"))));
503      assertEquals("b", Bytes.toString(result.getValue(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes("B"))));
504
505      result = table.get(new Get(row4));
506      assertEquals("d", Bytes.toString(result.getValue(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes("D"))));
507
508      result = table.get(new Get(row5));
509      assertEquals("f", Bytes.toString(result.getValue(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes("E"))));
510

674  private void testPreBatchMutate(TableName tableName, Runnable rn) throws Exception {
675    TableDescriptor tableDescriptor = TableDescriptorBuilder.newBuilder(tableName)
676      .setColumnFamily(ColumnFamilyDescriptorBuilder.of(FAMILY))
677      .setCoprocessor(WaitingForScanObserver.class.getName()).build();
678    try (Connection conn = getConnection(); Admin admin = conn.getAdmin()) {
679      admin.createTable(tableDescriptor);
680      // Don't use waitTableAvailable(), because the scanner will mess up the co-processor
681
682      ExecutorService service = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2);
683      service.execute(rn);
684      final List<Cell> cells = new ArrayList<>();
685      service.execute(() -> {
686        try {
687          // waiting for update.
688          TimeUnit.SECONDS.sleep(3);
689          try (Table t = conn.getTable(tableName)) {
690            Scan scan = new Scan();
691            try (ResultScanner scanner = t.getScanner(scan)) {
692              for (Result r : scanner) {
693                cells.addAll(Arrays.asList(r.rawCells()));
694              }
695            }
696          }
697        } catch (IOException | InterruptedException ex) {
698          throw new RuntimeException(ex);
699        }
700      });
701      service.shutdown();
702      service.awaitTermination(Long.MAX_VALUE, TimeUnit.DAYS);
703      assertEquals(0, cells.size(), "The write is blocking by RegionObserver#postBatchMutate"
704        + ", so the data is invisible to reader");
705    }
706  }

708  @TestTemplate
709  public void testLockLeakWithDelta() throws Exception, Throwable {
710    TableDescriptor tableDescriptor = TableDescriptorBuilder.newBuilder(tableName)
711      .setColumnFamily(ColumnFamilyDescriptorBuilder.of(FAMILY))
712      .setCoprocessor(WaitingForMultiMutationsObserver.class.getName())
713      .setValue("hbase.rowlock.wait.duration", String.valueOf(5000)).build();
714    TEST_UTIL.getAdmin().createTable(tableDescriptor);
715    TEST_UTIL.waitTableAvailable(tableName, WAITTABLE_MILLIS);
716
717    // new a connection for lower retry number.
718    Configuration copy = getClientConf();
719    copy.setInt(HConstants.HBASE_CLIENT_RETRIES_NUMBER, 2);
720    try (Connection con = ConnectionFactory.createConnection(copy)) {
721      HRegion region = (HRegion) find(tableName);
722      region.setTimeoutForWriteLock(10);
723      ExecutorService putService = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
724      putService.execute(() -> {
725        try (Table table = con.getTable(tableName)) {
726          Put put = new Put(ROW);
727          put.addColumn(FAMILY, QUALIFIER, VALUE);
728          // the put will be blocked by WaitingForMultiMutationsObserver.
729          table.put(put);
730        } catch (IOException ex) {
731          throw new RuntimeException(ex);
732        }
733      });
734      ExecutorService appendService = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
735      appendService.execute(() -> {
736        Append append = new Append(ROW);
737        append.addColumn(FAMILY, QUALIFIER, VALUE);
738        try (Table table = con.getTable(tableName)) {
739          table.append(append);
740          fail("The APPEND should fail because the target lock is blocked by previous put");
741        } catch (Exception ex) {
742        }
743      });
744      appendService.shutdown();
745      appendService.awaitTermination(Long.MAX_VALUE, TimeUnit.DAYS);
746      WaitingForMultiMutationsObserver observer =
747        find(tableName, WaitingForMultiMutationsObserver.class);
748      observer.latch.countDown();
749      putService.shutdown();
750      putService.awaitTermination(Long.MAX_VALUE, TimeUnit.DAYS);
751      try (Table table = con.getTable(tableName)) {
752        Result r = table.get(new Get(ROW));
753        assertFalse(r.isEmpty());
754        assertTrue(Bytes.equals(r.getValue(FAMILY, QUALIFIER), VALUE));
755      }
756    }
757    HRegion region = (HRegion) find(tableName);
758    int readLockCount = region.getReadLockCount();
759    LOG.info("readLockCount:" + readLockCount);
760    assertEquals(0, readLockCount);
761  }

763  @TestTemplate
764  public void testMultiRowMutations() throws Exception, Throwable {
765    TableDescriptor tableDescriptor = TableDescriptorBuilder.newBuilder(tableName)
766      .setColumnFamily(ColumnFamilyDescriptorBuilder.of(FAMILY))
767      .setCoprocessor(MultiRowMutationEndpoint.class.getName())
768      .setCoprocessor(WaitingForMultiMutationsObserver.class.getName())
769      .setValue("hbase.rowlock.wait.duration", String.valueOf(5000)).build();
770    TEST_UTIL.getAdmin().createTable(tableDescriptor);
771    TEST_UTIL.waitTableAvailable(tableName, WAITTABLE_MILLIS);
772
773    // new a connection for lower retry number.
774    Configuration copy = getClientConf();
775    copy.setInt(HConstants.HBASE_CLIENT_RETRIES_NUMBER, 2);
776    try (Connection con = ConnectionFactory.createConnection(copy)) {
777      byte[] row = Bytes.toBytes("ROW-0");
778      byte[] rowLocked = Bytes.toBytes("ROW-1");
779      byte[] value0 = Bytes.toBytes("VALUE-0");
780      byte[] value1 = Bytes.toBytes("VALUE-1");
781      byte[] value2 = Bytes.toBytes("VALUE-2");
782      assertNoLocks(tableName);
783      ExecutorService putService = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
784      putService.execute(() -> {
785        try (Table table = con.getTable(tableName)) {
786          Put put0 = new Put(rowLocked);
787          put0.addColumn(FAMILY, QUALIFIER, value0);
788          // the put will be blocked by WaitingForMultiMutationsObserver.
789          table.put(put0);
790        } catch (IOException ex) {
791          throw new RuntimeException(ex);
792        }
793      });
794      ExecutorService cpService = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
795      AtomicBoolean exceptionDuringMutateRows = new AtomicBoolean();
796      cpService.execute(() -> {
797        Put put1 = new Put(row);
798        Put put2 = new Put(rowLocked);
799        put1.addColumn(FAMILY, QUALIFIER, value1);
800        put2.addColumn(FAMILY, QUALIFIER, value2);
801        try (Table table = con.getTable(tableName)) {
802          MultiRowMutationProtos.MutateRowsRequest request =
803            MultiRowMutationProtos.MutateRowsRequest.newBuilder()
804              .addMutationRequest(
805                ProtobufUtil.toMutation(ClientProtos.MutationProto.MutationType.PUT, put1))
806              .addMutationRequest(
807                ProtobufUtil.toMutation(ClientProtos.MutationProto.MutationType.PUT, put2))
808              .build();
809          table.coprocessorService(MultiRowMutationProtos.MultiRowMutationService.class, ROW, ROW,
810            (MultiRowMutationProtos.MultiRowMutationService exe) -> {
811              ServerRpcController controller = new ServerRpcController();
812              CoprocessorRpcUtils.BlockingRpcCallback<
813                MultiRowMutationProtos.MutateRowsResponse> rpcCallback =
814                  new CoprocessorRpcUtils.BlockingRpcCallback<>();
815              exe.mutateRows(controller, request, rpcCallback);
816              if (
817                controller.failedOnException()
818                  && !(controller.getFailedOn() instanceof UnknownProtocolException)
819              ) {
820                exceptionDuringMutateRows.set(true);
821              }
822              return rpcCallback.get();
823            });
824        } catch (Throwable ex) {
825          LOG.error("encountered " + ex);
826        }
827      });
828      cpService.shutdown();
829      cpService.awaitTermination(Long.MAX_VALUE, TimeUnit.DAYS);
830      WaitingForMultiMutationsObserver observer =
831        find(tableName, WaitingForMultiMutationsObserver.class);
832      observer.latch.countDown();
833      putService.shutdown();
834      putService.awaitTermination(Long.MAX_VALUE, TimeUnit.DAYS);
835      try (Table table = con.getTable(tableName)) {
836        Get g0 = new Get(row);
837        Get g1 = new Get(rowLocked);
838        Result r0 = table.get(g0);
839        Result r1 = table.get(g1);
840        assertTrue(r0.isEmpty());
841        assertFalse(r1.isEmpty());
842        assertTrue(Bytes.equals(r1.getValue(FAMILY, QUALIFIER), value0));
843      }
844      assertNoLocks(tableName);
845      if (!exceptionDuringMutateRows.get()) {
846        fail("This cp should fail because the target lock is blocked by previous put");
847      }
848    }
849  }

851  /**
852   * A test case for issue HBASE-17482 After combile seqid with mvcc readpoint, seqid/mvcc is
853   * acquired and stamped onto cells in the append thread, a countdown latch is used to ensure that
854   * happened before cells can be put into memstore. But the MVCCPreAssign patch(HBASE-16698) make
855   * the seqid/mvcc acquirement in handler thread and stamping in append thread No countdown latch
856   * to assure cells in memstore are stamped with seqid/mvcc. If cells without mvcc(A.K.A mvcc=0)
857   * are put into memstore, then a scanner with a smaller readpoint can see these data, which
858   * disobey the multi version concurrency control rules. This test case is to reproduce this
859   * scenario.
860   */
861  @TestTemplate
862  public void testMVCCUsingMVCCPreAssign() throws IOException, InterruptedException {
863    TEST_UTIL.createTable(tableName, new byte[][] { FAMILY });
864    TEST_UTIL.waitTableAvailable(tableName, WAITTABLE_MILLIS);
865    try (Connection conn = getConnection(); Table table = conn.getTable(tableName)) {
866      // put two row first to init the scanner
867      Put put = new Put(Bytes.toBytes("0"));
868      put.addColumn(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes(""), Bytes.toBytes("0"));
869      table.put(put);
870      put = new Put(Bytes.toBytes("00"));
871      put.addColumn(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes(""), Bytes.toBytes("0"));
872      table.put(put);
873      Scan scan = new Scan();
874      scan.setTimeRange(0, Long.MAX_VALUE);
875      scan.setCaching(1);
876      try (ResultScanner scanner = table.getScanner(scan)) {
877        int rowNum = scanner.next() != null ? 1 : 0;
878        // the started scanner shouldn't see the rows put below
879        for (int i = 1; i < 1000; i++) {
880          put = new Put(Bytes.toBytes(String.valueOf(i)));
881          put.setDurability(Durability.ASYNC_WAL);
882          put.addColumn(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes(""), Bytes.toBytes(i));
883          table.put(put);
884        }
885        rowNum += Iterables.size(scanner);
886        // scanner should only see two rows
887        assertEquals(2, rowNum);
888      }
889      try (ResultScanner scanner = table.getScanner(scan)) {
890        int rowNum = Iterables.size(scanner);
891        // the new scanner should see all rows
892        assertEquals(1001, rowNum);
893      }
894    }
895  }

919  public static class WaitingForMultiMutationsObserver
920    implements RegionCoprocessor, RegionObserver {
921    final CountDownLatch latch = new CountDownLatch(1);
922
923    @Override
924    public Optional<RegionObserver> getRegionObserver() {
925      return Optional.of(this);
926    }
927
928    @Override
929    public void postBatchMutate(final ObserverContext<? extends RegionCoprocessorEnvironment> c,
930      final MiniBatchOperationInProgress<Mutation> miniBatchOp) throws IOException {
931      try {
932        latch.await();
933      } catch (InterruptedException ex) {
934        throw new IOException(ex);
935      }
936    }
937  }

939  public static class WaitingForScanObserver implements RegionCoprocessor, RegionObserver {
940    private final CountDownLatch latch = new CountDownLatch(1);
941
942    @Override
943    public Optional<RegionObserver> getRegionObserver() {
944      return Optional.of(this);
945    }
946
947    @Override
948    public void postBatchMutate(final ObserverContext<? extends RegionCoprocessorEnvironment> c,
949      final MiniBatchOperationInProgress<Mutation> miniBatchOp) throws IOException {
950      try {
951        // waiting for scanner
952        latch.await();
953      } catch (InterruptedException ex) {
954        throw new IOException(ex);
955      }
956    }
957
958    @Override
959    public RegionScanner postScannerOpen(
960      final ObserverContext<? extends RegionCoprocessorEnvironment> e, final Scan scan,
961      final RegionScanner s) throws IOException {
962      latch.countDown();
963      return s;
964    }
965  }

967  static byte[] generateHugeValue(int size) {
968    Random rand = ThreadLocalRandom.current();
969    byte[] value = new byte[size];
970    for (int i = 0; i < value.length; i++) {
971      value[i] = (byte) rand.nextInt(256);
972    }
973    return value;
974  }

976  @TestTemplate
977  public void testScanWithBatchSizeReturnIncompleteCells()
978    throws IOException, InterruptedException {
979    TableDescriptor hd = TableDescriptorBuilder.newBuilder(tableName)
980      .setColumnFamily(ColumnFamilyDescriptorBuilder.newBuilder(FAMILY).setMaxVersions(3).build())
981      .build();
982    try (Table table = TEST_UTIL.createTable(hd, null)) {
983      TEST_UTIL.waitTableAvailable(tableName, WAITTABLE_MILLIS);
984
985      Put put = new Put(ROW);
986      put.addColumn(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes(0), generateHugeValue(3 * 1024 * 1024));
987      table.put(put);
988
989      put = new Put(ROW);
990      put.addColumn(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes(1), generateHugeValue(4 * 1024 * 1024));
991      table.put(put);
992
993      for (int i = 2; i < 5; i++) {
994        for (int version = 0; version < 2; version++) {
995          put = new Put(ROW);
996          put.addColumn(FAMILY, Bytes.toBytes(i), generateHugeValue(1024));
997          table.put(put);
998        }
999      }
1000
1001      Scan scan = new Scan();
1002      scan.withStartRow(ROW).withStopRow(ROW, true).addFamily(FAMILY).setBatch(3)
1003        .setMaxResultSize(4 * 1024 * 1024);
1004      Result result;
1005      try (ResultScanner scanner = table.getScanner(scan)) {
1006        List<Result> list = new ArrayList<>();
1007        /*
1008         * The first scan rpc should return a result with 2 cells, because 3MB + 4MB > 4MB; The
1009         * second scan rpc should return a result with 3 cells, because reach the batch limit = 3;
1010         * The mayHaveMoreCellsInRow in last result should be false in the scan rpc. BTW, the
1011         * moreResultsInRegion also would be false. Finally, the client should collect all the cells
1012         * into two result: 2+3 -> 3+2;
1013         */
1014        while ((result = scanner.next()) != null) {
1015          list.add(result);
1016        }
1017
1018        assertEquals(5, list.stream().mapToInt(Result::size).sum());
1019        assertEquals(2, list.size());
1020        assertEquals(3, list.get(0).size());
1021        assertEquals(2, list.get(1).size());
1022      }
1023
1024      scan = new Scan();
1025      scan.withStartRow(ROW).withStopRow(ROW, true).addFamily(FAMILY).setBatch(2)
1026        .setMaxResultSize(4 * 1024 * 1024);
1027      try (ResultScanner scanner = table.getScanner(scan)) {
1028        List<Result> list = new ArrayList<>();
1029        while ((result = scanner.next()) != null) {
1030          list.add(result);
1031        }
1032        assertEquals(5, list.stream().mapToInt(Result::size).sum());
1033        assertEquals(3, list.size());
1034        assertEquals(2, list.get(0).size());
1035        assertEquals(2, list.get(1).size());
1036        assertEquals(1, list.get(2).size());
1037      }
1038    }
1039  }
